title: 第二十四章 观察第二十五章 面试
slug: 我都成超人了灵气才复苏
content_zh:
陈洛自认为。
以他目前的身体水平，还达不到可以称之为超凡的地步。
再联想到昨天清晨的奇异白雾，以及白雾后接二连三出现的翠绿词条。
他实在无法确定，自己是不是唯一的，有可能成为超凡的个体。
而在不确定，自己拥有足以凌驾于整个世界的力量之前，频繁地去抛头露面。
在陈洛看来，只会给自己，以及自己的家人带来无法预估的麻烦。
他很不喜欢。
因此。
在寻找词条，不断增强自己实力的同时。
陈洛亦没有放弃日常生活中的事宜。
最好的情况，是二者能够互相兼容，乃至相辅相成。
【隅中文化创意工作室】
便是他投下简历的实习单位之一。
这是一家小型自媒体工作室，以经营社交媒体账号，在视频网站发布视频为主要经营方式。
其拍摄方向，偏向纪录片。
主要聚焦于常人难以踏足的无人禁区，或难以了解到的社会角落、群体，还有都市流传已久的闹鬼地点等等。
作为初创公司，这家工作室的视频账号【隅中探秘】，截止目前，只发布了两个视频
第一个视频，标题为【阴阳两界】
拍摄内容为跟随殡葬行业的从业人员，详细了解其中各式工作流程、忌讳、奇闻怪谈，甚至请了一些相关的文化传承人，殡仪馆馆长，为拍摄团队一一解答问题。
第二个视频，标题为【天池探秘】

这期内容，针对某个景点内水下巨怪的传闻，前往传闻相关地点探寻。
视频中，拍摄团队不仅深入了禁止游客踏足的区域，还采访了夏尔联邦的相关工作人员，给予科学的解释。
当时的陈洛，在看完两个视频后，只有一个感想。
这个工作室团队的人脉，挺硬。
至于具体的福利待遇。
实习生每月工资六千。
除拍摄期间外，工作室没有强制的坐班要求，只需要按规定时间上下班打卡即可，且周末双休。
倘若有拍摄任务需要出外勤，则有对应的房补餐补以及各种补贴。
加班按照双倍工资，节假日再加一倍。
对于一份实习工作而言，这个待遇称得上夸张。
再加上。
陈洛很想知道，这些被汇聚无数人好奇、恐惧的奇闻轶事，怪谈地点，是否会有词条的存在。
因此，在看到招聘信息时，他便直接投下简历。
想到这里。
陈洛点开邮件，回复确认消息。
面试的地点，就定在距离澜海文理大学附近的某栋办公楼，时间则定在下午两点到五点。
见时间还算宽裕，陈洛便起床洗漱。
他下午得去工作室面试。
晚上则去李怀山家里做客。
至于上午的时间...

陈洛思来想去，决定去一些人流量较多的地方，看看能否找到零散的词条持有者。
于是乎。
content_en:
Chen Luo thought to himself.
With his current physical level, he still cannot reach the point where he can be called extraordinary.
Then think of the strange white mist yesterday morning, and the green entries that appeared one after another after the white mist.
He really wasn't sure if he was the only one who could possibly become an extraordinary individual.
And before he is sure that he has enough power to overpower the entire world, he frequently shows his face.
In Chen Luo's view, it will only bring unpredictable trouble to himself and his family.
He didn't like it very much.
therefore.
While looking for entries, continue to enhance your own strength.
Chen Luo also did not give up on matters in daily life.
The best case scenario is that the two are compatible with each other and even complement each other.
【Yuzhong Cultural and Creative Studio】
It was one of the internship units where he submitted his resume.
This is a small self-media studio that mainly operates social media accounts and publishes videos on video websites.
His shooting direction is towards documentaries.
It mainly focuses on uninhabited forbidden areas that are difficult for ordinary people to enter, or social corners and groups that are difficult to understand, as well as haunted places that have been circulated in the city for a long time, etc.
As a start-up company, this studio’s video account [Yuzhong Quest] has only released two videos so far.
The first video is titled [Yin and Yang Two Realms]
The content of the filming is to follow the practitioners in the funeral industry to learn more about the various work processes, taboos, and strange stories. We even invited some relevant cultural inheritors and funeral directors to answer questions for the filming team one by one.
The second video is titled [Tianchi Exploration]
This issue focuses on the rumors of underwater monsters in a certain scenic spot, and goes to the places related to the rumors to explore.
In the video, the filming team not only went deep into the area where tourists are prohibited from entering, but also interviewed relevant staff of the Shire Federation to give scientific explanations.
At that time, Chen Luo had only one thought after watching the two videos.
The connections of this studio team are quite strong.
As for specific benefits.
The monthly salary of interns is 6,000.
Except during the filming period, there are no mandatory working requirements in the studio. You only need to clock in and out at the specified time, and have weekends off.
If there is a shooting mission that requires field work, there will be corresponding room, meal, and various subsidies.
Overtime wages are doubled and wages are doubled during holidays.
For an internship, this treatment is exaggerated.
Plus.
Chen Luo wanted to know if there were any entries for these anecdotes, strange places and places that attracted countless people's curiosity and fear.
Therefore, when he saw the job posting, he directly submitted his resume.
Think of this.
Chen Luo clicked on the email and replied with a confirmation message.
The location of the interview was set at an office building near Lanhai University of Arts and Sciences, and the time was set from 2 to 5 pm.
Seeing that there was still plenty of time, Chen Luo got up and washed up.
He has to go to the studio for an interview in the afternoon.
In the evening, I went to Li Huaishan's house as a guest.
As for morning time...
Chen Luo thought about it and decided to go to some places with a lot of traffic to see if he could find scattered entry holders.
Ever since.
